Windows PCs


September 14, 2026


# More choice and possibility with Windows PCs at IFA


By


- [Mark Linton, Corporate Vice President, Windows & Devices](https://blogs.windows.com/devices/author/mark-linton/)


This year at IFA, I saw the Windows ecosystem doing what it does best: bringing innovation to life through products and experiences for every person, purpose, and price point. Our partners introduced new Windows PCs, spanning dependable everyday devices, beautifully crafted premium designs, new and immersive gaming systems, commercial devices designed to help organizations work securely and productively, and powerful tools for developers, creators, and AI power users. Together, these announcements demonstrated the breadth of what’s possible with a Windows PC.


This matters because people are being thoughtful about when, where, and how they spend. We know that a new PC is a meaningful purchase, and that customers want to feel confident that they choose the right PC for them. They want to know that it will deliver a better experience today while continuing to meet their needs for years to come. Windows PCs from our partners give people more ways to find the right device without compromising on what matters most to them.


## Innovation available today


For more than 40 years, our goal has been to put a computer on every desk and in every home. We know the PC is personal and the place you go to play, create, build, connect and learn. Some prioritize battery life and portability, while others need greater performance for gaming or creative work. And increasingly, people are also looking for useful AI experiences that are easy to use and fit seamlessly into their existing workflows. And of course, everyone needs to find the right device at the right price for them.


IFA showed how our partners are meeting those different needs. The strength of Windows is choice, and the latest Windows PCs bring together modern design, stronger performance, built-in security and useful AI experiences available at different price points. For those who have been holding on to an older PC, the choice and value available today makes it a good time to find the right device.


## Building the next era of the PC

also


demonstrated


how Windows is evolving for the next era of computing. The latest

PCs. It builds on the

Microsoft


Build, helping agents work within defined boundaries while taking advantage of the computing power available on the device.


We are also making it easier for


developers to


turn ideas into reality with


new ready-to-code Windows experiences


for next-generation devices.


By pre


-installing


the essential tools


and pre-configuring Windows settings for


development on


developer class devices with 64GB+ unified memory and 250gbps memory bandwidth,


developers can jump right in


.


Project Zenith devices enable developers to run capable coding models locally and unmetered, helping lower token


costs


,


experiment


more freely, and stay in their flow. Project Zenith shows how Windows and our ecosystem partners are bringing these innovations together to create more capable, purpose-built experiences.

### Acer


[Acer](https://www.acer.com/us-en/events/nextatacer) launched


the


[new Acer Vero 16](https://news.acer.com/acer-unveils-new-vero-16-laptop-designed-around-repairability-ai-powered-performance-and-a-commitment-to-reducing-environmental-impact) laptop, a


Copilot+ PC


designed to reduce waste and environmental impact throughout its lifecycle. As the fourth-generation Vero consumer laptop, the device debuts a new chassis design incorporating post-industrial recycled aluminum, low-carbon aluminum, and PCR plastic, along with


greatly expanded


repairability features. For uncompromising performance and all-day productivity, it is powered by Intel Core Ultra Series 3 processors with up to 180 platform TOPS.


Acer Vero 16


Acer’s Windows compute lineup at IFA 2026 also included the[Swift Blade 14](https://news.acer.com/acer-expands-thin-and-light-portfolio-with-799-g-swift-blade-14-laptop) , a 799-gram ultra-lightweight laptop for ultimate mobility; the[Acer SFF RTX Spark](https://news.acer.com/acer-showcases-design-powered-by-nvidia-rtx-spark-at-ifa-2026) reference design powered by the[NVIDIA RTX Spark superchip](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/products/rtx-spark/) for the age of personal AI agents; the[Acer Veriton RI110 AI Mini Workstation](https://news.acer.com/acer-introduces-veriton-ri110-ai-mini-workstation-for-powering-hybrid-agentic-ai-workloads) , a Copilot+ PC designed for agentic AI workflows; the[Aspire G 3D 16 laptop](https://news.acer.com/acer-launches-new-aspire-devices-for-creators-gamers-and-families) , powered by the AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 processor and offering Acer’s naked-eye 3D technology; the[Swift Air 16](https://news.acer.com/acer-expands-thin-and-light-portfolio-with-799-g-swift-blade-14-laptop) laptop with a premium aluminum chassis and Intel Core Series 3 processors; the[Predator Atlas 7](https://news.acer.com/acer-expands-gaming-handheld-portfolio-with-predator-atlas-7) gaming handheld; and the refreshed[Aspire S series](https://news.acer.com/acer-launches-new-aspire-devices-for-creators-gamers-and-families) all-in-one desktops.


## ASUS


At IFA, ASUS showcased the new[ProArt P16 and P14](https://press.asus.com/media/media-kit/ifa-2026-media-kit/) , powered by NVIDIA RTX Spark and running Windows 11. Designed for creators who need both performance and mobility, the ProArt P16 is the thinnest 16-inch RTX Spark laptop at just 12.9 mm, while the P14 is the lightest ProArt laptop ever at 1.48 kg, complemented by large 99Wh and 90Wh batteries and ASUS Lumina Pro OLED displays with up to 1,600-nit brightness and professional-grade color accuracy. The new lineup also introduces two distinctive ProArt expressions — Nano Black and Neo White — combining refined design with creator-focused functionality. ASUS brought these capabilities to life through its first global live showcase of agentic AI solutions for creators and developers, demonstrating how ProArt PCs can connect local AI, ASUS applications, and customizable workflows to transform creation, development, and production.


ProArt Laptop (Nano Black & Neo White)


## Dell


Dell[introduced the new Dell 14S](https://nam06.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.dell.com%2Fen-us%2Fblog%2Fstyle-battery-life-and-value-what-makes-the-best-affordable-college-laptop%2F&data=05%7C02%7Crohutchings%40microsoft.com%7C27d725d30bdf4066da4f08df0a02c551%7C72f988bf86f141af91ab2d7cd011db47%7C1%7C0%7C639240679263327000%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=tyLS1nrYoV4R%2Bn7ppKmdumIqZZm5vAT%2BXfkItmENfq0%3D&reserved=0) , a stylish, portable and dependable everyday Windows laptop built for students, young adults and anyone who wants a device that keeps up with their day. It comes in four expressive colors, Linen, Dusty Rose, Washed Denim and Velvet Green, so you can pick the one that reflects your personality and lifestyle. At just 1.15 kg and 13.5 mm thin, the refined aluminum build slips easily into a bag and travels well from class to coffee shop to couch. Two 16:10 panel options meet different priorities: a 2.8K 120Hz display for the sharpest, smoothest experience and a 2K 60Hz display for those prioritizing battery life and value. Both panel options are bright and provide vibrant, accurate colors. The Dell 14S offers up to 21 hours of Netflix streaming on a single charge1. That’s enough to carry you through a full day of classes, browsing, and everything in between, no scrambling for an outlet required.


Dell 14S Laptop


## Lenovo


[Lenovo](https://nam06.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fnews.lenovo.com%2Fpress-kits%2Finnovation-world-2026%2F&data=05%7C02%7Crohutchings%40microsoft.com%7Cef77d05d5bee4173d76a08df0ebb38ec%7C72f988bf86f141af91ab2d7cd011db47%7C1%7C0%7C639245869951615827%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=Flbw89EtsH%2F0%2F2mgHAZTwJwxqp%2B1C1lchsoJ4VsZhEU%3D&reserved=0) expanded its Yoga portfolio with two premium devices powered by NVIDIA RTX Spark. The[Yoga Pro 9n](https://nam06.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fnews.lenovo.com%2Fpressroom%2Fpress-releases%2Fyoga-portfolio-new-ai-pcs-and-tablets%2F&data=05%7C02%7Crohutchings%40microsoft.com%7Cef77d05d5bee4173d76a08df0ebb38ec%7C72f988bf86f141af91ab2d7cd011db47%7C1%7C0%7C639245869951671615%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=VwNLw7YB%2BNgvpkXjEfgtK5hRCxEVvGMonZyORhpAk5A%3D&reserved=0) is built for creators and developers, supporting demanding local AI, software development, content creation, and 3D rendering with up to 128GB of unified memory. The versatile[Yoga Pro 9n 2-in-1](https://nam06.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fnews.lenovo.com%2Fpressroom%2Fpress-releases%2Fyoga-portfolio-new-ai-pcs-and-tablets%2F&data=05%7C02%7Crohutchings%40microsoft.com%7Cef77d05d5bee4173d76a08df0ebb38ec%7C72f988bf86f141af91ab2d7cd011db47%7C1%7C0%7C639245869951680752%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=ePa%2BK9e48OYeBY1M%2FsefqFGrB4sQMZWON6o%2BQEEwrzA%3D&reserved=0) pairs substantial local performance with a flexible convertible design and a dual-surface pen experience, allowing creators to write and draw on either the OLED display or haptic Force Pad.


Yoga Pro 9n (15”, 11)


For students, families, and everyday users, the new[IdeaPad Vibe](https://nam06.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fnews.lenovo.com%2Fpressroom%2Fpress-releases%2Fcolorful-ideapad-vibe-series-all-in-one-ai-pcs%2F&data=05%7C02%7Crohutchings%40microsoft.com%7Cef77d05d5bee4173d76a08df0ebb38ec%7C72f988bf86f141af91ab2d7cd011db47%7C1%7C0%7C639245869951640452%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=8gL0NY%2BrNFHqY3fM9Yb4QYe8bE3uahGltTO0FCnC2F4%3D&reserved=0) series combines bold colors and lightweight designs with responsive performance and Copilot+ PC experiences. Available in 14- and 15-inch configurations, the lineup offers a choice of Snapdragon X or AMD Ryzen AI 400 Series processors. Lenovo also introduced the compact, cluster-ready[ThinkCentre X Ultra](https://nam06.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fnews.lenovo.com%2Fpressroom%2Fpress-releases%2Fhybrid-ai-for-business-devices-displays-solutions%2F&data=05%7C02%7Crohutchings%40microsoft.com%7Cef77d05d5bee4173d76a08df0ebb38ec%7C72f988bf86f141af91ab2d7cd011db47%7C1%7C0%7C639245869951652547%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=XMXBTSHZoX%2FNEvzF28V6%2F7391YT1V27uL9FV%2BVsAYmY%3D&reserved=0) for advanced business AI workloads, the streamlined[IdeaCentre AIO i](https://nam06.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fnews.lenovo.com%2Fpressroom%2Fpress-releases%2Fcolorful-ideapad-vibe-series-all-in-one-ai-pcs%2F&data=05%7C02%7Crohutchings%40microsoft.com%7Cef77d05d5bee4173d76a08df0ebb38ec%7C72f988bf86f141af91ab2d7cd011db47%7C1%7C0%7C639245869951662329%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=cVW2yt%2B1ohvYGLbZnUmkxehw9%2FcBKwTl8Z1KmHbDiL0%3D&reserved=0) , and the ultra-slim[ThinkBook 14 Gen 9](https://nam06.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fnews.lenovo.com%2Fpressroom%2Fpress-releases%2Fhybrid-ai-for-business-devices-displays-solutions%2F&data=05%7C02%7Crohutchings%40microsoft.com%7Cef77d05d5bee4173d76a08df0ebb38ec%7C72f988bf86f141af91ab2d7cd011db47%7C1%7C0%7C639245869951690235%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=xYyGQfgwbAPUSynquMe%2FQffsXeKrYmMpuxU1CfIidMY%3D&reserved=0) for mobile, AI-enhanced productivity.


IdeaPad Vibe


## **MSI**


MSI announced the new Venture 15 AI+ B3M at IFA. Featuring a highly efficient[Intel Core Ultra X7 358H](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/sku/245527/intel-core-ultra-x7-processor-358h-18m-cache-up-to-4-80-ghz/specifications.html) processor, a 144Hz 100% sRGB display, comprehensive I/O connectivity, and Windows 11, the Venture 15 AI+ B3M is a versatile productivity laptop that also handles gaming needs with ease.


Venture 15


## AMD


AMD Senior Vice President and General Manager Jack Huynh delivered the event’s opening[keynote](https://nam06.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fwatch%3Fv%3DXT7fGf28hJ0&data=05%7C02%7Crohutchings%40microsoft.com%7C38e4391f212c49c2578608df0fa0cba0%7C72f988bf86f141af91ab2d7cd011db47%7C1%7C0%7C639246855445717423%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=UUsCIv5TkN4y%2FZsPKTK2tGyiMSepaejHoG21RfHJNwo%3D&reserved=0) on “The Era of Personal AI,” exploring how agentic, on-device intelligence can make technology more personal, private, and adaptive. AMD announced that[Ryzen AI Halo](https://nam06.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.amd.com%2Fen%2Fproducts%2Fprocessors%2Fdesktops%2Fryzen%2Fryzen-ai-halo.html&data=05%7C02%7Crohutchings%40microsoft.com%7C38e4391f212c49c2578608df0fa0cba0%7C72f988bf86f141af91ab2d7cd011db47%7C1%7C0%7C639246855445765025%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=7LiBOmgfo5iizsuq2CgVsdTXKTrZUuJUnZMTdO9iAmg%3D&reserved=0) systems will support[Microsoft’s Project Zenith](https://nam06.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fblogs.windows.com%2Fwindowsdeveloper%2F2026%2F09%2F04%2Fannouncing-project-zenith-the-ready-to-code-windows-experience%2F&data=05%7C02%7Crohutchings%40microsoft.com%7C38e4391f212c49c2578608df0fa0cba0%7C72f988bf86f141af91ab2d7cd011db47%7C1%7C0%7C639246855445800248%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=5WUcrt3xwiAVOpD2Hgo4DRwadTsOKuZvMEzF7CGMqlo%3D&reserved=0) out of the box, providing developers with a ready-to-code Windows experience that includes Visual Studio Code, WSL, GitHub Copilot CLI, and PowerShell. AMD also previewed the[Threadripper Halo Station](https://nam06.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.amd.com%2Fen%2Fproducts%2Fworkstations%2Famd-threadripper-halo-station.html&data=05%7C02%7Crohutchings%40microsoft.com%7C38e4391f212c49c2578608df0fa0cba0%7C72f988bf86f141af91ab2d7cd011db47%7C1%7C0%7C639246855445831363%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=IxeAK2tEFU6tF5X%2FjpUohxzWu08K9D729TzvILPdT2A%3D&reserved=0) , a prototype desktop workstation designed to bring datacenter-class AI compute to developers. New AMD-powered OEM systems announced at IFA included Acer’s Aspire G AGB110 mini-PC and Aspire G 3D 16 notebook, alongside Lenovo’s ThinkCentre X Ultra, ThinkCentre M75s Gen 6, ThinkCentre M75q Gen 6, and IdeaPad Slim 3, all powered by AMD Ryzen AI Max 400 Series processors.


Ryzen AI Halo


## NVIDIA


This year at IFA,[NVIDIA showcased](https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/local-ai-ifa-next-gen-agents-nv-pair-rtx-spark/) how it’s accelerating local AI and new ways to make local AI agents easier and faster to run on Windows. Highlights include simplified local model setup coming in Hermes Agent, OpenClaw and Perplexity Portable Computer; inference optimizations delivering up to 1.9x faster performance; and NVIDIA PAIR, a new open-source tool that distributes AI workloads across compatible PCs. NVIDIA and its partners also announced that NVIDIA RTX Spark Windows PCs will arrive in October 2026.


NVIDIA RTX Spark Superchip


## Innovating together for what comes next


I want to thank our partners across the Windows ecosystem for the ingenuity, investment, and collaboration they bring to customers every day. IFA reflected what is possible when Windows, silicon, hardware and software innovation come together. The momentum we saw in Berlin was only the beginning. As computing becomes more personal and intelligent, our ecosystem will continue to turn new technology into practical experiences that help empower people and organizations to do more. I am excited about what we are building together and, even more importantly, about what our customers will do with it.
